_comment: Long-history proxies for extending UCITS ETF series back past their
inception (scripts/extend_history.py). The binding constraint on the
whole validation stack is T (SPA blocked at ~8y); proxies buy decades.
confidence: 'high' = well-known same-index US listing; 'low' = best
guess, VERIFY before trusting. null proxy = no mapping yet — fill in.
extend_history.py refuses any proxy whose overlap-return correlation
with the real ETF falls below --min-corr, so a wrong mapping fails
loudly instead of silently polluting the extended cache.
NOTE: most proxies quote in USD while the ETFs quote in GBP/EUR/CHF —
pre-inception returns are the proxy's currency returns. Fine for
regime / relative-performance research; NOT precise GBP returns.

EXSA.note: STOXX Europe 600 vs S&P Europe 350 — close cousins

WSML.note: EAFE small vs World small — ex-US only, verify corr

ASHR.note: same fund family US listing, CSI 300, 2013+

AGGU.note: US agg vs global agg USD-hedged, 2003+

SEGA.note: intl treasuries vs euro govt — verify corr

TIGG.note: global inflation-linked ex-US, 2008+ — verify vs TIP

COMM.note: broad commodities — verify which index COMM tracks

ICOM.note: GSCI vs BCOM weighting differs — verify corr

EMMCHA.note: MSCI EM, 2003+ — ETF is CHF-hedged, hedge drag differs
